limits: Four synthetic cases, three repetitions per model; exploratory and task-specific
Code case is review/repair choice, not live patch implementation
QA read-only bootstrap differs from earlier Main-session tests; do not pool
Isolation is workspace-confined read tools, not OS sandboxing; keys and peer outputs outside candidate workspace
Independent model oracle reviewer timed out without a verdict; Main checked deterministic reference/seed controls, state replay and recovery reducer plus supplied source statements
No hidden reasoning stored or graded
Intermediate narration is reported separately from final JSON parsing
recommendation: Preserve this as a fixed regression screen; no overall model ranking or automatic route promotion. Future work should add a few independently validated real-work cases rather than repeat easy cases indefinitely.

Exact complete evidence packages 1/3 each due citation/unknown-list omissions; no invented acceptance-rate finding. S3-vs-null is scored under frozen decisive-source requirement, not a false factual assertion.
